description: This file defines the ManagedGrafanaClient class used to interact with the Amazon Managed Grafana service, including method signatures for various operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: ManagedGrafanaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Managed Grafana service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: associateLicense
methods.description: Associates a license with the Grafana workspace.

methods.name: createWorkspace
methods.description: Creates a new Grafana workspace.

methods.name: createWorkspaceApiKey
methods.description: Creates an API key for a workspace.

methods.name: createWorkspaceServiceAccount
methods.description: Creates a service account for a workspace.

methods.name: createWorkspaceServiceAccountToken
methods.description: Creates a token for a workspace service account.

methods.name: deleteWorkspace
methods.description: Deletes a specified workspace.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceApiKey
methods.description: Deletes an API key from a workspace.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceServiceAccount
methods.description: Deletes a service account from a workspace.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceServiceAccountToken
methods.description: Deletes a token for a workspace service account.

methods.name: describeWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves details about a workspace.

methods.name: describeWorkspaceAuthentication
methods.description: Describes the authentication configuration of a workspace.

methods.name: describeWorkspaceConfiguration
methods.description: Describes the configuration of a workspace.

methods.name: disassociateLicense
methods.description: Disassociates a license from a workspace.

methods.name: listPermissions
methods.description: Lists permissions for a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists available versions.

methods.name: listWorkspaceServiceAccountTokens
methods.description: Lists tokens for a workspace service account.

methods.name: listWorkspaceServiceAccounts
methods.description: Lists service accounts for a workspace.

methods.name: listWorkspaces
methods.description: Lists all workspaces.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updatePermissions
methods.description: Updates permissions for a resource.

methods.name: updateWorkspace
methods.description: Updates a workspace.

methods.name: updateWorkspaceAuthentication
methods.description: Updates workspace authentication settings.

methods.name: updateWorkspaceConfiguration
methods.description: Updates workspace configuration.
